label: repeated i input mid original phase (i/h-heavy prefix)
explanation: Ultra-sparse feature (0.0035% of steps). About 84% of activation mass is on input i during the original phase at steps 3-7, mostly t=4-5, and it grows when the prefix already holds several i/h tokens (in_count of i 3-5 has 20-400x lift; prev_tok h has 14x lift). The strongest example is i f i i h i at step 5 (an i right after h with three earlier i). A small remainder sits on <DEL> right after such i runs. It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. Precision is very low: even with the i/h-prefix condition, only about 7% of matching steps activate, so the trigger condition is incomplete. The best predicate reaches F1 ~0.13-0.19 on dev with mass recall 0.74.
